Definition: from G5087; a receptacle, i.e. scabbard:--sheath.
BiblicalUsage: thḗkē stands behind the English phrase a sheath, a scabbard. In John 18:11, Put up thy sword into the sheath.
TheologicalSignificance: Jesus telling Peter to put his sword back in its sheath teaches me that His kingdom is not defended by my blade.
